thread:
sam: FYI — Cross-region capacity drill next Tue 04/12 04:00-05:00 UTC. Goal: validate automatic regional fallback and autoscale under simulated eu->us failover. Expect short SLO annotations and internal alert suppression. Please ack if you need to opt out. :white_check_mark:

lee: Ack. Which services are in scope?

sam: In-scope: inference-gateway, kv-cache, routing-layer. Out-of-scope: billing and telemetry ingestion. See runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/eng-sre/cross-region-capacity-drill

anika: I'll run the traffic generator and watch qps patterns. Planning a phased ramp: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% of typical peak over 20min.

oncall: I'll be on-call that window. If p99 increases >2x or error-rate >0.5%, we'll pause ramp and investigate. Who owns KV cache validation?

lee: I'll own KV cache validation. Quick preflight: ensure replication lag < 50ms and miss rate < 3%. Command snippets in runbook.

deploy-bot: Preflight job scheduled at 03:40 UTC: health-checks+metric-exports. Job ID: preflight-194123-pre1

monitor-bot: Preflight results: all services GREEN except kv-replica-7 showing 58ms lag (warn). Recommend swapping replica before ramp.

anika: Swapped replica and retested. KV lag now 22ms. Ready to start at 04:00.

sam: Customer-facing SLA unaffected. We'll enable an "internal SLO leniency" tag for the window so internal burn rules ignore expected transient spikes. Ops runbook says to avoid noisy external alerts unless customer impact detected.

lee: Added dashboard annotation and temporary alert suppression for pager policies: eng-sre/critical-pager suppressed for 65m window. Retain external ops-email alerting.

anika: Starting ramp step 1 -> 10% at 04:00. Watching latencies.

monitor-bot: Ramp 10% complete: latency p95 +3ms, errors 0.001%.

anika: Proceeding to 30% -> 60% -> holding for KV warmup.

oncall: Observed a tail-latency spike on routing-layer during 60% step, spike lasted ~90s. Pausing ramp. Collecting traces.

lee: Looking at traces: a misconfigured connection pool on routing-proxy caused transient queueing. Hotfix: increase pool size from 50 -> 100 on proxy-group-eu. Applying now.

deploy-bot: Hotfix deploy started to proxy-group-eu. Job ID: hotfix-194123-pool1

deploy-bot: Hotfix deploy completed: status=PASS, rollout=100%, latency impact reverted.

monitor-bot: Post-hotfix: p95 latency within baseline, errors cleared. Resuming ramp to 100% with conservative step (80% for 5min).

anika: Ramp to 100% completed by 04:40. KV cache miss rate stable at 1.8%. No customer-facing errors found.

oncall: Good run. We'll keep internal SLO leniency for another 30m to collect cooldown metrics, then remove annotation.

sam: Postmortem notes (short): cause = connection-pool sizing mismatch in routing-proxy under high concurrency. Action items: add pool auto-tune (lee), add canary for pool-size changes (anika), update preflight to include synthetic concurrency test (sam).

lee: I'll own the pool auto-tune RFC. ETA end of sprint.

anika: I'll add canary job to the deploy pipeline this week.

oncall: Closing the drill. Final runbook update: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/eng-sre/cross-region-capacity-drill#postmortem. Thanks team. :tada:
